taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Bori-police-station, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Bori-police-station, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Bori-police-station, Bori Metropolis**

The vertical electrical sounding (VES) model identifies a 4-layer geoelectric sequence:
- **Layer 1:** 150.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 1.23 m (topsoil)
- **Layer 2:** 97.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 6.21 m (depth to base 7.44 m)
- **Layer 3:** 284.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 37.5 m (depth to base 45.0 m)
- **Layer 4:** 700.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, infinite thickness (deep resistive unit)

**Curve Type Verification:**  
- Layers 1–3: $\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$ ($150 > 97.1 < 284$), forming an **H**-type curve.  
- Layers 2–4: $\rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$ ($97.1 < 284 < 700$), forming an **A**-type curve.  

The combined soundings confirm an **HA**-type curve, matching the interpreted classification on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "HA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
